trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:** The latest production release of checkout-api, v2.3.1, was failing health checks (18% error rate). The versions history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 across all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), so I verified the state — us-west and eu-west were still on the bad v2.3.1 — and retried. All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.
2. **Incident:** Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001, "checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the partial rollback retry. The creation request timed out on my end, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created and is open, and the on-call engineer has been paged.
